title: Start the Operator Station: verify AGVs/main disconnect, reset flashing ESTOP, home axes, and press CYCLE START
summary: Bring the operator station from an off/faulted state to the tipper “ready” state by verifying AGVs are powered and the main disconnect is ON, clearing flashing ESTOP faults via HMI RESET, homing all tipper axes (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2) using AUTO REF, then pressing CYCLE START to move from “home” to “ready” and placing the tipper into AUTO mode so it waits for WCS instructions.
when_to_use: Use when the operator station has been turned off or is in a faulted/off state and you need to start it so the tipper can home and then wait for WCS instructions in AUTO mode.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the operator station startup actions (verify AGVs/main disconnect, reset flashing ESTOP, home axes via AUTO REF, press CYCLE START, set tipper to AUTO).
safety_notes: If the ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP and press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults before continuing with homing and cycle start.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station HMI screen (RESET, AUTO REF, CYCLE START, and mode/status indicators)

system_preconditions: System has been turned off (or is not yet started): follow the startup procedure to start the system.
Verify the AGVs are powered on.
Verify the main disconnect is ON.
external_references: Reference P40A (V2.0) user manual, Document version: V1.1 (20231206) for instructions on starting the AGVs.

steps.title: Verify AGVs are powered on
steps.purpose: Ensure the fleet/AGVs are available before starting the operator station.
steps.instruction: Verify the AGVs are powered on.
steps.expected_result: AGVs are powered on (observable at the site’s AGV power status indicators).

actions.label: Check AGV power status
actions.exact_action: Verify the AGVs are powered on.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 1. Verify the AGVs are powered on.

steps.title: Verify main disconnect is ON
steps.purpose: Confirm the operator station power path is enabled before resetting ESTOP and homing axes.
steps.instruction: Verify the main disconnect is ON.
steps.expected_result: Main disconnect is ON (observable at the main disconnect indicator/label).

actions.label: Check main disconnect
actions.exact_action: Verify the main disconnect is ON.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 2. Verify the main disconnect is ON.

steps.title: Reset flashing ESTOP faults via HMI RESET
steps.purpose: Clear any ESTOP-related faults so homing and cycle start can proceed.
steps.instruction: At the operator station control panel, if the ESTOP is flashing: pull out the ESTOP, then press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults.
steps.expected_result: Flashing ESTOP fault is cleared after pulling out ESTOP and pressing RESET on the HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: ESTOP is no longer flashing and faults clear on the HMI.
steps.failure_condition: ESTOP remains flashing and faults do not clear after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET.

actions.label: Press HMI RESET
actions.exact_action: press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults

stop_or_escalate_if: If the ESTOP is flashing and faults do not clear after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET, stop and escalate to support rather than continuing homing/cycle start.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 3. At the operator station control panel, if the ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP and press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults.

steps.title: Home all tipper axes using AUTO REF (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2)
steps.purpose: Reference the tipper axes to the “home” position before starting the cycle.
steps.instruction: Home every axis (Z1 and A1 for the left tipper; Z2 and A2 for the right tipper) by pressing AUTO REF. Watch the axis button color change from green to yellow while it is moving; the tipper motor moves until it senses the “home” proximity switch, then stops.
steps.expected_result: All axes home successfully: axis button changes green → yellow while moving, then the tipper motor stops when the “home” proximity switch is sensed.
steps.healthy_condition: Axis buttons show green-to-yellow transition during motion and then stop at the home proximity switch.
steps.failure_condition: Axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed, or the tipper motor does not stop at the “home” proximity switch.
stop_or_escalate_if: If axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed, or if the tipper motor does not stop at the “home” proximity switch, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 4. "Home" every axis: Z1 and A1 (left tipper) and Z2 and A2 (right tipper): a. Press AUTO REF. The axis button changes from green to yellow to indicate it is moving. The tipper motor moves until it senses the "home" proximity switch, then stops.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to move from home to ready
steps.purpose: Start the tipper operation cycle after homing so it reaches the “ready” state.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE START. Confirm the motor moves from “home” to “ready.”
steps.expected_result: Motor moves from “home” to “ready” after pressing CYCLE START.
steps.healthy_condition: After CYCLE START, the displayed state transitions from home to ready and motor movement corresponds to that transition.
steps.failure_condition: CYCLE START does not move the motor from “home” to “ready.”
stop_or_escalate_if: If CYCLE START does not move the motor from “home” to “ready”, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5. Press CYCLE START. The motor moves from "home" to "ready."

steps.title: Place tipper in AUTO mode to wait for WCS instructions
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is in the correct operating mode to receive instructions from WCS.
steps.instruction: Place the tipper in AUTO mode. Confirm the tipper will wait for the WCS to send instructions.
steps.expected_result: Tipper is in AUTO mode and is waiting for WCS instructions.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper mode/status indicates AUTO mode (and no manual-only fault/jog context is active).
steps.failure_condition: Tipper is not in AUTO mode or does not wait for WCS instructions.

actions.label: Set AUTO mode
actions.exact_action: Place the tipper in AUTO mode.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 6. Place the tipper in AUTO mode. The tipper will wait for the WCS to send instructions.

success_criteria: If ESTOP was flashing, it is cleared after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET.
All axes home successfully: axis button changes green → yellow while moving and then stops when the “home” proximity switch is sensed.
Pressing CYCLE START moves the motor from “home” to “ready.”
Tipper is placed in AUTO mode and waits for WCS instructions.
healthy_conditions: ESTOP is not flashing and HMI faults are cleared.
AUTO REF homing shows axis button green → yellow transition and then stops at the home proximity switch.
CYCLE START transitions the motor from home to ready.
Tipper mode indicates AUTO and is waiting for WCS instructions.
failure_conditions: ESTOP remains flashing and faults do not clear after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET.
AUTO REF does not produce the expected green → yellow axis button movement indication, or the motor does not stop at the home proximity switch.
CYCLE START does not move the motor from home to ready.
Tipper is not in AUTO mode / does not wait for WCS instructions.
escalation_guidance: If ESTOP faults do not clear after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET, stop and escalate to support rather than continuing homing/cycle start.
If homing via AUTO REF does not show the expected axis button color change or the motor does not stop at the home proximity switch, stop and escalate.
If CYCLE START does not move the motor from home to ready, stop and escalate.
